purpose: Determine whether iteration007 failed because the frozen public representation cannot distinguish opposing targets, temporal information is missing, value/credit targets conflict, the dataset is imbalanced, or optimization alone was insufficient. This audit is not a game-strength test and does not reject RL generally.

canonical_identities.P: Canonical current public_projection with no target, future, opponent-id, seed, or engine action index.
canonical_identities.O: The immutable raw_observation_sha256 because the full raw observation was not persisted. Exact O comparisons are supported; field-level O differences are not claimed.
canonical_identities.L: Sorted multiset of canonical legal semantic-action identities.
canonical_identities.a: Selected semantic option canonicalized from option_type, source_card_id, target_card_id, and every public payload field; engine_index is excluded.
canonical_identities.X: Byte-exact float32 concatenation of the frozen iteration004 state_encoder output and selected action_encoder output. Legal-set identity remains separately bound by L.
canonical_identities.row_id: ppo_row_ordinal plus episode_id and decision_index, all three required to agree.

near_identity_levels.public_one_unit: Same L+a and exactly one differing flattened public scalar whose numeric distance is one, or one boolean flip.
near_identity_levels.public_two_units: Same L+a and at most two public one-unit scalar differences.
near_identity_levels.legal_multiset_one_or_two: Same P+a and legal semantic-action multiset symmetric difference exactly one or two.

latent_mutual_knn.distance: Euclidean distance after per-dimension median-absolute-deviation scaling of X

target_contract.exact_conflict: An exact identity class contains both robust positive and robust negative signs.
target_contract.strong_conflict: Each robust sign occurs in at least two distinct source trajectories.
target_contract.unweighted_irreducible_wrong_sign_mass: sum over classes of min(positive_row_count, negative_row_count)
target_contract.loss_weight: absolute normalized training advantage, matching the unclipped ratio-one PPO policy-loss contribution
target_contract.weighted_irreducible_wrong_sign_mass: sum over classes of min(sum positive loss weights, sum negative loss weights)

trajectory_credit_decomposition.reward_channel_limitation: The dataset persists one scalar reward channel; no additional unrecorded reward-channel decomposition is claimed.
trajectory_credit_decomposition.clipping_or_reweighting: Advantages are not clipped or reweighted before the full-batch PPO objective. PPO ratio clipping is recorded separately and equals the execution contract.

gradient_contract.operations: Autograd Jacobian and gradient evaluation only; no optimizer may be constructed or stepped.
gradient_contract.stage1_reconstruction: Use iteration004 residual_head.0 and the iteration007 terminal residual_head.2, which was frozen after Stage1.
gradient_contract.stage16_limitation: No update16 parameter bytes were persisted. Report probability-space movement from the 830 stored update16 diagnostics; do not replay optimizer updates or claim an unavailable parameter-space gradient.

classification_thresholds.representation_collision: Strong O+L+a to X+L+a collisions explain at least 50 percent of priority anti-or-neutral loss weight.
classification_thresholds.missing_temporal_information: Adding the prior two public actions and public-state deltas reduces exact O+L+a conflict mass by at least 50 percent and covers at least 10 priority rows or two failed groups.
classification_thresholds.value_or_credit_conflict: At least 50 percent of conflict loss weight changes or resolves under Monte-Carlo-advantage polarity, with flips attributable to bootstrap/value, GAE horizon, or normalization terms.
classification_thresholds.dataset_imbalance: A failed target direction reverses under both equal-state and equal-trajectory weighting and either effective trajectory sample size is at most 50 percent of nominal or the top 10 percent of trajectories provide at least 50 percent of weight.
classification_thresholds.mere_optimization_failure: All preceding material causes fail, near-neighbor target agreement is at least 90 percent, GAE and Monte-Carlo sign agreement is at least 90 percent, reweighting preserves direction, all six group-isolated signed derivatives are favorable, and the intermediate-parameter evidence contract is complete.

decision_rule: The audit may classify one or more evidenced causes, but it must not select an architecture, target, or optimizer change. A later Sol-Ultra strategy judgment selects exactly one improvement hypothesis from the immutable audit outputs.
